whyChoose.title: Why Choose Interview Coach
whyChoose.subtitle: The only platform that combines unlimited AI practice with real human coaching — so you're always one step ahead.
whyChoose.aiDesc: Practice 24/7 with our AI that adapts to your role, experience level, and target company. Get instant scoring and detailed feedback on every answer.
whyChoose.coachDesc: Book 1-on-1 sessions with experienced coaches from top companies. Get personalised advice, live feedback, and insider tips you can't get from AI.
whyChoose.trackDesc: Monitor your progress across both AI sessions and coach feedback. See your scores improve over time with detailed analytics and personalised coaching plans.

features.title: Everything You Need to Ace Your Interview
features.aiInterviewerDesc: Practice with our advanced AI that adapts to your responses and provides realistic interview scenarios.
features.instantFeedbackDesc: Get comprehensive analysis on your answers including strengths, areas for improvement, and specific suggestions.
features.customizableDesc: Tailor interviews to your industry, role, experience level, and focus on your weak areas.
features.multiLanguageDesc: Practice interviews in over 10 languages including English, Spanish, French, German, Arabic, and more.
features.progressTrackingDesc: Monitor your improvement over time with detailed analytics and performance metrics.
features.unlimitedDesc: No limits on practice sessions. Keep improving until you feel 100% confident.

howItWorks.title: How Interview Coach Works
howItWorks.sectionDescription: Use AI practice, book a coach session, or combine both for the best results.
howItWorks.aiStep1Desc: Select your target job, industry, and level. The AI adapts everything to you.
howItWorks.aiStep2Desc: Answer realistic questions in real-time. The AI responds like a real interviewer.
howItWorks.aiStep3Desc: See your score, confidence level, ideal answer, and what to improve after each question.
howItWorks.aiStep4Desc: Track scores over time and keep practising until you feel completely ready.
howItWorks.coachStep1Desc: Filter by industry, experience level, price, and rating. Read reviews from past candidates.
howItWorks.coachStep2Desc: Choose a date, time, and session length that works for you. Pay securely online.
howItWorks.coachStep3Desc: Join a video call with your expert coach. Practice interview scenarios in real time.
howItWorks.coachStep4Desc: Receive a personalised report with actionable next steps and improvement areas.
